Captures and inspects the raw LLM requests OpenCode sends to providers, and the responses that come back.

## Features

- **Auto-fetch controls** — a toggle and interval dropdown (5s / 10s / 30s / 1m) that refresh the session list and the open session's requests on a timer. Off by default; both the toggle and the chosen interval persist across reloads. The same change replaced every native `<select>` in the viewer with a themed listbox, so option menus now follow the app's own light/dark tokens instead of the OS widget ([ADR 006](https://github.com/tranphucbol/opencode-wiretap/blob/v0.2.0/docs/decisions/006-dropdowns-are-a-custom-listbox.md)) — 18977f2
- **Raw JSON viewer** — inspect a capture's unformatted payload — c0b4d11
- **Capture log retention** — captures are pruned a whole session at a time on a retention window, 15 days by default via `WIRETAP_RETENTION_DAYS`, `0` to keep everything ([ADR 005](https://github.com/tranphucbol/opencode-wiretap/blob/v0.2.0/docs/decisions/005-captures-pruned-by-session-age.md)) — 854aa61
- **Response capture and per-request cost** — the response half is recorded into its request's file, and cost is computed at read time from OpenCode's models.dev rates, with a background sweep for session totals ([ADRs 002–004](https://github.com/tranphucbol/opencode-wiretap/tree/v0.2.0/docs/decisions)) — 93a7744
- **Request copy and OpenAI model badges** — 98f6344

## Fixes

- **Deduplicate wrapped fetch requests** — a wrapped `fetch` no longer records the same call twice — 4698b30

## Install

```bash
# viewer
bunx opencode-wiretap-viewer   # or: npx opencode-wiretap-viewer
```

The plugin publishes as `opencode-wiretap`. Both packages release in lockstep at the same version.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tranphucbol/opencode-wiretap/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0
